subject: Close-readout & checklist: procurement / legal workflow for Arcadia Health
messages:
From: Danielle Ross <danielle.ross@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: ProcureOps <procure@arcadiahealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement checkpoint — MSA redlines + vendor setup items

Hi team,

Thanks for the demo last week — Arcadia stakeholders want to move to signature this month. Before we can route to our procurement legal group for final sign-off we need a concise MAP-style checkpoint covering:

- Status of MSA redlines (we attached our annotated redlines)
- Final order form (pricing, committed capacity, billing contact)
- Vendor setup prerequisites (account details, firewall IP allowlist, SSO options)
- Any evidence you can share for SOC2 / retention / audit logging to satisfy our security review

Can you confirm owners and expected dates for each item? We have a weekly gating call on Friday, 2027-06-04 at 10:00 AM ET — would like a short readout beforehand.

Attachments: Arcadia_MSA_Redlines_20270525.pdf

Thanks,
Danielle Ross
Sr. Manager, Procurement Ops
Arcadia Health

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Danielle Ross <danielle.ross@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-31T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement checkpoint — MSA redlines + vendor setup items

Danielle — thanks for the clear list and for sending the redlines. High-level status and owners below; I also attached an updated order form (v1.3) with the committed capacity and billing block for your review.

1) MSA redlines — owner: Legal (Rishi). ETA: initial pass by 2027-06-02, final negotiation by 2027-06-07.
2) Order form (pricing/term) — owner: Soojin / Lauren. ETA: final sign-ready copy by 2027-06-01 (we sent v1.3 attached).
3) Vendor setup checklist — owner: Karthik. ETA: pre-prod network details next 48 hours; full onboarding runbook by 2027-06-03.
4) SOC2 / evidence package — owner: Security; we will provide SOC2 summary, data retention notes, and audit log samples. ETA: 2027-06-02.

Meeting: Friday 2027-06-04 10:00 AM ET works for our side. If OK I’ll send a 30-minute agenda focused on gating items and signature path.

Attachments: RDW_OrderForm_Arcadia_v1.3.xlsx

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Danielle Ross <danielle.ross@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement checkpoint — MSA redlines + vendor setup items

Danielle / Soojin — quick vendor setup rundown and ask so your infra team can start provisioning. Below are the concrete items and current ETA:

- Account creation: We need a service account name and point-of-contact (POC) to create your tenant — ETA: 24 hours after POC provided.
- IP allowlist: provide the public IP ranges your security team will allow; we can accept a CIDR list or individual addresses. (Sample IPs: 34.82.112.0/24, 35.197.0.0/16)
- SSO: We support SAML 2.0; if you want SSO, share IdP metadata. Otherwise we can provision local accounts for initial testing.
- Data flow & retention: short doc attached describing retention defaults and how to request custom retention windows.

Owner commitments: Karthik — vendor setup runbook by 2027-06-03; will hand off to Arcadia POC for account provisioning.

Attachments: vendor-setup-checklist-arcadia.pdf

On Fri, May 31, 2027 at 08:45 AM Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Danielle — thanks for the clear list and for sending the redlines. High-level status and owners below; I also attached an updated order form (v1.3) with the committed capacity and billing block for your review.

From: Danielle Ross <danielle.ross@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: ProcureOps <procure@arcadiahealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-03T16:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement checkpoint — MSA redlines + vendor setup items

Thanks everyone — this is helpful. Quick confirmations:

- We reviewed RDW_OrderForm_Arcadia_v1.3 and can proceed on DocuSign once legal signs off on the MSA redline margin items (Rishi, will you confirm when you have a signable MSA?).
- Procurement will circulate a DocuSign envelope for the order form to the billing contact listed in v1.3 — please confirm the billing email is billing@arcadiahealth.com (that is correct for us).
- For vendor setup, I’ll assign a POC (Leah Patel, leah.patel@arcadiahealth.com) by EOD tomorrow to enable tenant creation.

Action items we’ll track in the MAP:
- Rishi: MSA counter with track changes — due 2027-06-02 (if earlier that helps).
- Soojin / Lauren: confirm final price block and sign-ready order form — due 2027-06-01 (Soojin: please confirm if any outstanding discounts need approval).
- Karthik: onboarding runbook + IP allowlist template — due 2027-06-03.
- Arcadia ProcureOps: send DocuSign envelope once MSA is sign-ready.

Please add these to the MAP and share the single meeting agenda ahead of Friday 10:00 AM ET. DocuSign link (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/en/sign/embedded/abcd-arcadia-orderform

Best,
Danielle
Sr. Manager, Procurement Ops
Arcadia Health
